when: high altitude with moderate or wet moisture, at any temperature: mountain forests
cold, with moderate or wet moisture, at low or mid altitude: northern woods, bogs and riversides
mild, with moderate or wet moisture, at low or mid altitude: temperate woodland
hot, with moderate or wet moisture, at low or mid altitude: tropical coasts and rainforest
hot and dry, at any altitude: deserts
mild and dry, at any altitude: sunny Mediterranean groves and slopes
cold and dry, at any altitude: moors, heaths and bare rocky ground
